name: Camanchaca S.A.
summary: Camanchaca S.A. engages in the industrial fishing business in Chile, the United States, Mexico, Japan, Europe, and China. The company produces fishmeal, frozen and canned jack mackerel, langostino lobster, and fish oil in northern and southern Chile; and engages in salmon farming activities. It is also involved in farming mussels, frozen horse mackerel, prawns, and shrimp, abalones, and shellfish, as well as logistics operations. In addition, the company exports fish and shellfish to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as Compañía Pesquera Camanchaca S.A. Camanchaca S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
